name: ballerinax/ai.aws.dynamodb

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents a distinct error type for memory store errors.

typeDefs.name: TableConfig
typeDefs.description: Configuration for the DynamoDB table that backs the short-term memory store.

fields.name: tableName
fields.description:
The name of the DynamoDB table used to store chat messages.
Must be 3-255 characters long and contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots, and hyphens

fields.name: createTableIfNotExists
fields.description:
Whether the store should create the backing table when it does not
already exist. Defaults to `true`. When `true`, initialization calls `DescribeTable` (and
`CreateTable` if the table is absent), which requires the `dynamodb:DescribeTable` and
`dynamodb:CreateTable` IAM permissions. Set to `false` when the table is provisioned out of band
(e.g. via IaC) and the runtime role is restricted to data-plane permissions; in that case the
store performs no control-plane calls during initialization and assumes the table already exists

fields.name: billingMode
fields.description:
The billing mode to request when the connector creates the table. Defaults to
`dynamodb:PAY_PER_REQUEST` (on-demand). Note that this differs from the AWS `CreateTable` API
default of `PROVISIONED`; set this explicitly to `dynamodb:PROVISIONED` (and provide
`readCapacityUnits`/`writeCapacityUnits`) for provisioned-capacity tables. Ignored when
`createTableIfNotExists` is `false` or the table already exists

fields.name: readCapacityUnits
fields.description: The read capacity units to provision when `billingMode` is `dynamodb:PROVISIONED`

fields.name: writeCapacityUnits
fields.description: The write capacity units to provision when `billingMode` is `dynamodb:PROVISIONED`

fields.name: consistentReads
fields.description:
Whether reads against DynamoDB use strongly consistent reads. Defaults to `false`
(eventually consistent), matching the DynamoDB default. Strongly consistent reads cost twice the read
capacity units of eventually consistent reads; set to `true` only when strong consistency is required

fields.name: tags
fields.description:
Optional tags to apply to the DynamoDB table when the connector creates it. Ignored if the
table already exists

fields.name: sseSpecification
fields.description:
Optional server-side encryption settings to apply when the connector creates
the table. If omitted, the table uses the default AWS-owned encryption key. Ignored if the table
already exists

typeDefs.name: ShortTermMemoryStore
typeDefs.description: Initializes the DynamoDB-backed short-term memory store.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the DynamoDB-backed short-term memory store.

parameters.name: dbConnection
parameters.description: The DynamoDB client or connection configuration to connect to DynamoDB

parameters.name: maxMessagesPerKey
parameters.description: The maximum number of interactive messages to store per key

parameters.name: tableConfig
parameters.description:
Configuration for the DynamoDB table that backs the store, including the table
name, whether to auto-create the table, billing mode, provisioned throughput, read consistency,
tags, and server-side encryption

functions.name: getChatSystemMessage
functions.description: Retrieves the system message, if it was provided, for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description:
A copy of the message if it was specified, nil if it was not, or an
`Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: getChatInteractiveMessages
functions.description:
Retrieves all stored interactive chat messages (i.e., all chat messages except the system
message) for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: A copy of the messages, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: getAll
functions.description: Retrieves all stored chat messages for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: A copy of the messages, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: put
functions.description: Adds one or more chat messages to the memory store for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

parameters.name: message
parameters.description:
The `ChatMessage` message or messages to store. If multiple
`ChatSystemMessage` values are provided in an array, only the last one is
persisted; earlier system messages in the array are discarded.

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: removeChatSystemMessage
functions.description: Removes the system chat message, if specified, for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description:
nil on success or if there is no system chat message against the key,
or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: removeChatInteractiveMessages
functions.description:
Removes all stored interactive chat messages (i.e., all chat messages except the system
message) for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

parameters.name: count
parameters.description:
Optional number of messages to remove, starting from the first interactive message in;
if not provided, removes all messages

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: removeAll
functions.description:
Removes all stored chat messages for a given key, including any pending human-in-the-loop
approval checkpoint for that key, so an abandoned pause does not retain its whole history
snapshot indefinitely. The message deletion and the checkpoint deletion are separate
DynamoDB calls and are not atomic; if the second call fails, the error is returned and the
checkpoint is left in place for a retry.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: isFull
functions.description: Checks if the memory store is full for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: true if the memory store is full, false otherwise, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: getCapacity
functions.description: Retrieves the maximum number of interactive messages that can be stored for each key.

return.description: The configured capacity of the message store per key

functions.name: putCheckpoint
functions.description: Stores (or replaces) the pending human-in-the-loop approval for its session.

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: getCheckpoint
functions.description:
Returns the pending human-in-the-loop approval for a session, if any.

Uses `consistentReads` (defaults to `false`, eventually consistent). A `getCheckpoint` call
made shortly after `putCheckpoint` can therefore return `()` even though a checkpoint was
just stored. Set `consistentReads` to `true` if callers need read-after-write for this. Note
`takeCheckpoint` is unaffected - `DeleteItem` (with `ReturnValues`) is always strongly
consistent, regardless of `consistentReads`.

return.description: The pending approval, nil if none is pending, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: removeCheckpoint
functions.description: Removes the pending human-in-the-loop approval for a session, if any.

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: takeCheckpoint
functions.description:
Fetches and removes the pending human-in-the-loop approval for a session. Uses DynamoDB's
`ReturnValues: ALL_OLD` on the delete so the fetch-and-remove happens as a single atomic
operation - a concurrent duplicate resume for the same session cannot also claim and execute
the same approved tool call.

return.description: The claimed pending approval, nil if none was pending, or an `Error` if the operation fails
